subject: Deploy shiny app with packages from R-Forge

messages.author: 02a6189806c6baa7
messages.subject: Deploy shiny app with packages from R-Forge
parts:
Hi, I am wondering how I can deploy my shiny app with packages installed from r-forge? I only found a similar question on RStudio Support but it seems to be a very old question. The answer is that Shiny does not support packages from r-forge. Is there any way I can do to solve it?

Many thanks.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Deploy shiny app with packages from R-Forge
parts:
ShinyApps.io does not support r-forge at the moment, see:
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!msg/shinyapps-users/Ox2TUtVo_QQ/OUsa0oMRCgAJ

Sometimes the same package may also be available on GitHub, if so you can install from GitHub using devtools::install_github, then it should work.
